deviation: The draft keeps written acceptance and has no deemed acceptance, but it drops the guaranteed minimum of 10 business days of testing and replaces it with an undefined "reasonable period". It also never says that silence or delay is not acceptance. This leaves room for the supplier to argue that Arcadia accepted by lapse of time or that its testing window was too short.
suggested_text: 7.2 A Deliverable is accepted only when Customer confirms acceptance in writing after not less than 10 business days of testing, which period starts on the later of delivery of the Deliverable and delivery of the relevant test results. Customer shall review each Deliverable against the description in this SOW and the agreed acceptance criteria and shall either accept it in writing or notify Supplier of non-conformities in reasonable detail. Neither silence, delay nor any other failure by Customer to respond constitutes acceptance. [Keep 7.1, 7.3 and 7.4 as drafted.]
